title: Identity/set args
description: Arguments for Identity/set (RFC 8621 §6.3). Clients may only update identities; create and destroy are server-controlled.

accountId.description: The account to update Identity objects in.

ifInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard on Identity state.

create.description: Map of creation id to Identity create objects. This server does not support client-initiated creation.

update.description: Map of Identity id to IdentityUpdate patch objects.

destroy.description: Ids to destroy. This server does not support client-initiated destruction.
